answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon issues an unpredictable challenge, and every agent must answer in minutes with a compute heartbeat. New agents dock at a wharf, staking a 20-unit deposit burned if the heartbeat fails, so a knoll of idle fakes cannot hide. Forging 100 identities costs 2,000 units, while one fake earns at most 5, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and earn full rewards undiluted.
